text:
marta-finance: FYI partner 'NeonInterconnect GmbH' (DE) just emailed asking us to gross-up revenue-share payments for Q4 '23. They say German tax authorities insisted on 15% WHT on 'royalty-like' payments and they included a TRC and an invoice. Attachment: neon_q4_payments.xlsx, neon_trc.pdf

tom-legal: Can you paste the contract clause re: reseller/revenue share? Need to see whether it's licensing/royalty vs service.

alex-gtm: They resell our Dedicated seats + a 20% referral revenue share — functionally reseller margin. Not licensing IP to them.

marta-finance: Amount is ~€42,300 net paid last quarter. Partner asking for retro gross-up (i.e., pay them extra to cover WHT). Is that allowed?

sarah-cfo: How material? If we gross-up, that increases COGS by ~€7.5k. Would impact gross margin; need legal/tax confirmation.

partner-billing-bot: Uploaded files: neon_q4_payments.xlsx, neon_trc.pdf

tom-legal: Quick read — TRC looks OK but doesn't automatically justify royalty treatment. Germany can impose WHT depending on characterization.

marta-finance: I checked with partner; they claim German tax authority told them it's royalties for their commission. They provided a German letter but it's not clear.

tom-legal: We should get an external tax opinion. Also need the full contract, SOWs and actual invoicing docs. Also confirm whether payments routed via EU entity or to their DE bank.

alex-gtm: Payments were made to their DE bank account; contract countersigned by Neon DE. Contract section 5 attached below.

alex-gtm: ```Contract — Section 5: Partner shall receive a revenue share equal to 20% of net subscription revenue attributable to referrals. No grant of IP or license to Redwood technology is made to Partner.```

tom-legal: That clause reads like service/commission. Suggest tax would argue no WHT. But get advisor.

marta-finance: Can we ask partner to accept reclassification and sign waiver so we avoid retro gross-up? Or do we just pay gross-up and adjust moving forward?

sarah-cfo: Approve external tax advisor up to €1,500 to get a formal opinion. If opinion says no WHT required, we push partner to return funds or offset future payments.

tom-legal: I'll loop in external tax counsel (KPMG DE). Marta, send me the contract + invoices + TRC; I'll ping them.

marta-finance: On it. Drafting reply to partner to request the signed tax letter, bank remittance proof, and to pause any collection demands until we finish review. @alex-gtm — pls confirm you can share the signed contract PDF.

alex-gtm: Confirmed. I'll drop the signed PDF in #finance-uploads now.

marta-finance: Thanks — target to close in 3 business days. I'll keep everyone posted. :pray:
